name: threejs-postprocessing
title_zh: 给 Three.js 场景加电影级后期特效
tagline_zh: Bloom 辉光、景深、调色、屏幕空间着色器，一行接入 EffectComposer。不用翻文档拼管线。
tagline_en: Bloom, DOF, color grading, screen-space shaders — drop into EffectComposer without digging through docs. Plug.
desc_en: Three.js post-processing - EffectComposer, bloom, DOF, screen effects. Use when adding visual effects, color grading, blur, glow, or creating custom screen-space shaders.
why_zh: 把官方示例里散落的后期代码收敛成声明式配置，按需组合 pass，自动处理尺寸与顺序，改参数即时生效。
why_en: Consolidates scattered official examples into declarative pass configs — auto-handles sizing and order, tweak params live.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 WebGLRenderer 的 EffectComposer 链路，不碰 CSS3DRenderer 或 We。
limit_en: Only for WebGLRenderer's EffectComposer chain, not CSS3D/WebGPU. Requires three ≥ r150 installed; older versions break API calls.
